patho.author: Marra P, Dulcetta L, Carbone FS, Muglia R, Muscogiuri G, Cheli M, D'Antiga L, Colledan M, Fagiuoli S, Sironi S
patho.note: Panneau (a) seul : Doppler couleur du tronc porte extra-hépatique. Les panneaux TDM b et c ont été exclus pour garder la modalité échographique. Le syndrome de Budd-Chiari n'est pas sur cette figure.
patho.caption_source: Color-Doppler Ultrasound and CT images of portal vein thrombosis in a 54-year-old male suffering from liver cirrhosis. (a) Color-Doppler Ultrasound image shows a narrow hepatopetal flow (arrow) despite a large endoluminal thrombus in the extrahepatic portal trunk. (b) Portal phase coronal CT image shows the lack of luminal enhancement and increased portal vein caliber due to a large endoluminal thrombus in the extrahepatic trunk (arrow). (c) Portal phase axial CT image shows the extension of the portal vein thrombosis up to the splenomesenteric confluence (white arrow); liver cirrhosis is visible on the the liver surface that presents lobulated margins (black arrows).

arrows.definition: Thrombose porte : matériel endoluminal large du tronc porte extra-hépatique, ne laissant qu'un flux hépatopète étroit au Doppler couleur.
